mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `user` (username, name, password, email, phone, age, gender, status, state) VALUES
(#{u.username}, #{u.name}, #{u.password}, #{u.email}, #{u.phone}, #{u.age}, #{u.gender}, #{u.status}, #{u.state})
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.age, u.gender, u.status, u.create_time, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR '、') AS role_names FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.age, u.gender, u.status, u.create_time ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT u.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `user` u WHERE u.status = '1' GROUP BY u.state
